params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Wukong}} gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} based on level and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} equal to a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'', which stacks up to 5 times.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack, '''Wukong''' increases the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} gained.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{pplevel|4.5 to 10}} '''bonus''' armor}}|armor}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{fd|{{ap|0.35/10}}}}% of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}

Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} with his {{tip|basic attacks}} or {{tip|abilities}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
params.description2: {{sbc|Strength of Stone:}} For each stack,{{ft|''Stone Skin's'' effects are increased by 100%,|'''Wukong''' gains {{as|{{pplevel|4.5 to 10}} '''additional bonus''' armor|armor}} and further regenerates an additional {{as|{{fd|0.35}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds,}}up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|4.5*6 to 10*6}} '''bonus''' armor}} and total additional regeneration of{{ft|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6}}% '''maximum''' health}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|0.35*6/10}}% '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
params.notes: * Stacks of ''Strength of Stone'' are also granted {{tip|on-hit}}, but will specifically not be if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Wukong gains bonus armor based on level and health regeneration equal to a portion of his maximum health.

blurb2.plain: Whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy champion or monster, he generates a stack of Strength of Stone, which stacks up to 5 times.

blurb4.plain: Strength of Stone: For each stack, Wukong increases the bonus armor and health regeneration gained.

description.plain: Innate: Wukong gains 4.5 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and regenerates an additional 0.35% of his maximum health every 5 seconds. Whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy champion or monster with his basic attacks or abilities, he generates a stack of Strength of Stone for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.

description2.plain: Strength of Stone: For each stack, Stone Skin's effects are increased by 100%, up to a maximum of 27 – 60 (based on level) bonus armor and total additional regeneration of 2.1% maximum health every 5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Wukong}} next basic attack within a few seconds will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for a short time.
params.blurb2: The cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and then inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 3 seconds.
params.description2: ''Crushing Blow's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy.
params.description3: ''Crushing Blow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Wukong's''' and his {{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone's}} basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.''
params.notes:
* The {{tip|basic attack}} portion of ''Crushing Blow'' is tagged as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, while the bonus damage portion is {{tip|proc damage}}.
* ''Crushing Blow'' triggers on {{tip|turret|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}} but the armor reduction is not applied.
* Issuing a Hold command (default {{sbc|J}}) or Stop command (default {{sbc|S}}) after ''Crushing Blow's'' attack has started will cancel the animation, however the attack will still be launched and '''Wukong''' will be unable to move until that point.

blurb.plain: Active: Wukong next basic attack within a few seconds will gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage, and inflict armor reduction for a short time.

blurb2.plain: The cooldown is reduced whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy.

description.plain: Active: Wukong empowers his next basic attack within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and then inflict armor reduction for 3 seconds.

description2.plain: Crushing Blow's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy.

description3.plain: Crushing Blow resets Wukong's and his clone's basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wukong}} enters brief {{tip|invisibility}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} for a short time.
params.blurb2: The clone can attack autonomously and gains the effects of his other abilities, as well as casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' when '''Wukong''' does.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' enters {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second and {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a {{tip|clone}} of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
params.description2: The clone is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy '''Wukong''' damaged. It can also gain the effects of ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}'' and ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, and casts ''{{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}}'' whenever '''Wukong''' does.
params.description4: ''See [[Wukong#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Wukong's''' clone. '''Wukong''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
params.notes:
* Casting ''Warrior Trickster'' during an ability's effects will transfer them to the clone.
* {{tip|Turret}} shots instantly kill the clone.
* The clone is immune to {{tip|stasis}} and {{ui|Blast Cone}}.
* The clone can still be targeted by allied {{tip|auto-targeted}} effects (e.g. {{si|Heal}}, {{ai|Celestial Blessing|Kayle}}).
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
params.tips: * Issuing a Hold (default {{sbc|J}}), Stop (default {{sbc|S}}) or Toggle (default {{sbc|Ctrl + 5}}) command will play '''Wukong's''' idle animation, which is the same animation that plays for his clone upon spawning. This can effectively cause enemies to mistake '''Wukong''' for his clone (as vice versa) for a short duration.

blurb.plain: Active: Wukong enters brief invisibility and dashes to the target location, leaving behind a clone for a short time.

blurb2.plain: The clone can attack autonomously and gains the effects of his other abilities, as well as casts Cyclone when Wukong does.

description.plain: Active: Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.

description2.plain: The clone is untargetable to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy Wukong damaged. It can also gain the effects of Crushing Blow and Nimbus Strike bonus attack speed, and casts Cyclone whenever Wukong does.

description4.plain: See Pets for more details about Wukong's clone. Wukong can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wukong}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy and sends {{tip|untargetable}} clones to briefly attack up to two surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: Upon arrival, '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location and sends out {{tip|untargetable}} ''clones'' to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description2: Upon arrival, '''Wukong''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}} can be cast during the dash.''

blurb.plain: Active: Wukong dashes to the target enemy and sends untargetable clones to briefly attack up to two surrounding enemies, dealing magic damage.

blurb2.plain: Upon arrival, Wukong gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

description.plain: Active: Wukong dashes to the target enemy's location and sends out untargetable clones to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing magic damage.

description2.plain: Upon arrival, Wukong gains bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

description3.plain: Crushing Blow can be cast during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wukong}} spins his staff around for a short time, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. The staff continually deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}, and can briefly {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once.
params.blurb2: ''Cyclone'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. He cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within a period after the first cast has ended.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wukong''' spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. The staff deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit, and can {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} once for {{fd|0.6}} seconds. ''Cyclone'' will not {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies who were already hit by either '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' within the same cast.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|8/8 to 16/8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275/8}}% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 16}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 275% AD)}}}}
params.description2: ''Cyclone'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another {{tip|ability}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Wukong''' ends ''Cyclone''. After 1 second, he can cast ''Cyclone'' a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.
params.leveling3: {{st|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|8*2 to 16*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|275*2}}% AD)}}}}
params.description4: ''{{ais|Nimbus Strike|Wukong}}'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.
params.description5: ''Cyclone's'' damage is capped at {{pp|200 to 600 for 3|6;11;16}} per second against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* ''Cyclone'' is special cased to grant stacks of {{ri|Conqueror}} for each tick of damage.
* Casting a basic ability will always interrupt '''Wukong's''' ''Cyclone''. A clone can be interrupted by casting {{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}, but only if the clone was made during the current ''Cyclone'' cast and only for that cast. This means if both '''Wukong''' and his clone are spinning, the clone cannot be interrupted.
* ''Cyclone's'' remaining duration always stays the same even after the clone replicated the ability.
* During ''Cyclone'', '''Wukong''' and his clone's {{sti|attack ranges|link=range}} are reduced{{ft|to 50|by 125}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block one instance of damage.
** Blocking the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} will still grant immunity to it from either of ''Cyclone's'' casts.
{{ct|attack=false|move=true|cast=Other abilities are disabled for the first {{fd|0.3}} seconds, casting them afterwards interrupts.|items=true|consume=true|spells=true,true,true,false,true|interrupts=death}}

blurb.plain: Active: Wukong spins his staff around for a short time, becoming ghosted and gaining bonus movement speed. The staff continually deals physical damage to enemies hit based on their maximum health, and can briefly knock them up once.

blurb2.plain: Cyclone can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

blurb3.plain: Recast: Wukong ends Cyclone. He cast Cyclone a second time within a period after the first cast has ended.

description.plain: Active: Wukong spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 20% bonus movement speed. The staff deals physical damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies hit, and can knock them up once for 0.6 seconds. Cyclone will not knock up enemies who were already hit by either Wukong or his clone within the same cast.

description2.plain: Cyclone can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another ability.

description3.plain: Recast: Wukong ends Cyclone. After 1 second, he can cast Cyclone a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.

description4.plain: Nimbus Strike bonus attack speed duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.

description5.plain: Cyclone's damage is capped at 200 / 400 / 600 (based on level) per second against monsters.
